Team —

Quick passoff notes for TheraHealth (SOW signed yesterday). High-level context so CS/Implementation can pick up without a lengthy hunt:

Deal summary
- Contract: 6-month pilot + option to expand to enterprise; SOW executed and e-signed (attached).
- Go-live target: 2027-07-15 (customer expects production traffic by mid-July).
- Pricing/credits: pilot capped at 500k tokens/month; overage terms in SOW.

Key non-standard terms (please flag if any of these will affect onboarding cadence):
- Data residency: US-only (customer asked for region pinning).
- Dedicated tenancy requested: they want a dedicated capacity pool (reserved GPUs) starting on go-live date.
- Security: completed initial questionnaire; they will push a vendor SOC 2 addendum.

Technical & product context
- Recommended model: redwood-small-v2 (we tested for latency/cost profile).
- Pre-prod traffic profile: expected 30–50RPS peak during pilot, ramping after month 1.
- Integration: server-side REST API calls from their platform (no client-side SDK). They want SSO (SAML) + API key fallback for service accounts.

Attachments: Ther aHealth_SOW_signed.pdf, post-signature-checklist.xlsx

Ask to CS/Implementation
1) Confirm main CSM and Implementation owner.
2) Confirm preflight window and list of required actions for Sprint 0 (env provisioning, SSO, allowlist, test data ingestion).
3) Note any blocker from our side (e.g., capacity reservation lead time).

Customer contacts (intro in separate thread — I’ll loop them in after you confirm owners):
- Karen Li, Head of AI Platform (karen.li@therahealth.com)
- Sam Walker, Engineering Lead (sam.walker@therahealth.com)
- Procurement team (procurement@therahealth.com)

Ben will remain on thread as AE support. Vivek — quick signal if there are infra constraints for dedicated pool startup that could slip the go-live date.

Thanks —
Aditya Rao
Director, Sales
Redwood Inference

Thanks Aditya — tagging into Evelyn's inbox.

Acknowledged. I’ll own the overall CSM relationship. Monica, would you take Implementation Lead for this engagement? Vivek, will need you for preflight and capacity planning.

Immediate clarifying Qs (to ensure we don’t miss a blocker):
- Procurement: who owns contractual onboarding (Procurement has to complete PO or we issue invoice)? Aditya / Ben — please confirm timeline.
- SSO: do we have SAML metadata from customer yet? If not, prod SSO can be parallel to API-key for early testing.
- Test data: can Karen/Sam provide a small synthetic dataset and example calls for preflight validation?
- Dedicated pool: Vivek — how long to reserve capacity once we approve? Lead time estimate will determine whether our July 15 date holds.

Proposed internal timeline / next meeting
- Sprint 0 (preflight): May 31–Jun 11 (2 weeks)
- Sprint 1 (integration + scale test): Jun 14–Jul 2
- Go-live prep & final acceptance: Jul 5–Jul 14
- Go-live: Jul 15

If you’re ok with those windows I’ll send a kickoff invite for Monday, May 31. I’ll also draft a short runbook and share the post-signature checklist.

Evelyn Hart
Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

Hi all — thanks for the context. Happy to lead Implementation.

High-level Sprint 0 checklist (what I’ll own + what I’ll need from TheraHealth):
- Redwood tasks (I’ll coordinate):
  • Provision pre-prod environment (region: us-west-2) and create sandbox API keys (ETA 3 business days after kickoff).
  • Create allowlist template and IP ranges for customer to confirm.
  • Coordinate SAML metadata ingestion and test SSO.
  • Run initial smoke tests against sample payloads and share logs.

- Customer deliverables (please confirm):
  • SAML metadata + IdP contact (for SSO test) — owner: Karen
  • Test dataset or schema and 3 example API calls — owner: Sam
  • PO / Procurement ticket to finance (if needed) — owner: Procurement team

I’m attaching the post-signature checklist I use for Sprint 0 (post-signature-checklist.xlsx) and a quick runbook link. I’ll open a Confluence page under /Shared/TheraHealth/Implementation and seed it with tasks.

Proposed kickoff: Mon 2027-05-31 10:00 AM PT — 30 min sync to align owners and immediate blockers. After that, 3x/week standups for the first two weeks (15 min) to keep ramp tight.

Questions for Aditya/Ben: any outstanding compliance evidence they still expect to receive from our security team before kickoff?

Thanks —
Monica Patel
Implementation Lead, Customer Success
Redwood Inference
